title: Different needs meet a gentle response
meaning: Combining different ways of participating for mutuality is emotionally answered by gentle steadiness around a powerful impulse.
text: Different wishes can remain alive without a forceful collision. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions where you combine different needs and ways of participating. The Lovers in energy give a motive to seek mutuality and remain turned towards each other. Strength in emotions adds a feeling of gentle mastery of impulse. The overall tone can therefore be considerate: you practically accommodate differences for a living response and emotionally notice that excitement or irritation does not occupy the whole space between you.

For example, you choose how to spend a free day: one person wants movement, while the other wants a quiet conversation. A walk and a stop somewhere calm become parts of the common plan. Wanting to be together supports the combination, although each person initially defends their wish strongly. **Our wishes differ, and this impulse can be handled gently.** Satisfaction concerns emotional steadiness, rather than personal preferences disappearing or your paces becoming completely identical. Both wishes can remain recognisable.

A difficulty arises if gentleness becomes the compulsory price of having a place in the plan. Strong dissatisfaction must then be hidden to avoid seeming to reject mutuality. Strength requires no suppression, and the Lovers as motivation do not cancel different responses. Temperance in action also makes no combination final: a tired participant may experience the same plan differently, without proving that the wish to be beside the other person has disappeared.
